name: hermes-lot-map-tests
description: A live activity map for Hermes Desktop, based on [Panoptes](https://github.com/huwhitememes/panoptes) and using the original renderer from [lot-map](https://github.com/alexeyw/lot-map). It shows a map beside the chat, with stations for tools, files, shell, web, browser, agents, memory, and user interaction.
